instruction.text: Find all the adverbs in the text.

atoms.b: ((After)) Jamie woke up, she ran ((downstairs)) to see if it had snowed. She ((immediately)) gazed out the window and saw pure white. ((Then)) she sprinted back ((upstairs)) and ((before long)) she was wrapped up warm, ready to go outside.

instruction.text: Select the correct time adverbs to fill in the gaps.

atoms.b: ((++Firstly Lastly)), Jamie and her sister built a huge snowman, and ((++then before)) they went sledging. It was ((++already afterwards)) dark, so they went inside. ((++Later Yesterday)), they had a nice cup of hot chocolate to warm themselves up.

instruction.text: Choose the connective adverbs to add to the conversation.

atoms.b: Will you be able to come to the party on Friday? Everyone will be there, and it will be a lot of fun ((++as_a_result lazily)).
Unfortunately, my boss has asked me to do some extra work, and I have to stay in the office. I would come ((++otherwise dramatically)).
You could ((++also speedily)) come a bit later on. ((++Besides Firstly)), none of our friends are very punctual.
Oh good idea! I don’t know how long the work will take, ((++however quickly)), I will let you know.
